title: Sunflower with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x="46" y="65" width="8" height="30" rx="3" fill="#3CB043"/>
  <!-- Leaf left -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="78" rx="12" ry="6" fill="#4CD964" transform="rotate(-25 34 78)"/>
  <!-- Leaf right -->
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="84" rx="11" ry="5.5" fill="#2E8B37" transform="rotate(25 66 84)"/>
  <!-- Petals: bright yellow, arranged around center -->
  <g fill="#FFD700">
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="14" rx="7" ry="12"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="56" rx="7" ry="12"/>
    <ellipse cx="22" cy="35" rx="12" ry="7"/>
    <ellipse cx="78" cy="35" rx="12" ry="7"/>
    <ellipse cx="30" cy="18" rx="7" ry="11" transform="rotate(-45 30 18)"/>
    <ellipse cx="70" cy="18" rx="7" ry="11" transform="rotate(45 70 18)"/>
    <ellipse cx="30" cy="52" rx="7" ry="11" transform="rotate(45 30 52)"/>
    <ellipse cx="70" cy="52" rx="7" ry="11" transform="rotate(-45 70 52)"/>
    <ellipse cx="18" cy="26" rx="6" ry="10" transform="rotate(-70 18 26)"/>
    <ellipse cx="82" cy="26" rx="6" ry="10" transform="rotate(70 82 26)"/>
    <ellipse cx="18" cy="44" rx="6" ry="10" transform="rotate(70 18 44)"/>
    <ellipse cx="82" cy="44" rx="6" ry="10" transform="rotate(-70 82 44)"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Petal highlights for depth -->
  <g fill="#FFE84D">
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="14" rx="4" ry="8"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="56" rx="4" ry="8"/>
    <ellipse cx="24" cy="35" rx="8" ry="4"/>
    <ellipse cx="76" cy="35" rx="8" ry="4"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Center face -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="35" r="17" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="35" r="14" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="30" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FFF3B0"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="30" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#FFF3B0"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="31" r="1.6" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="31" r="1.6" fill="#5C2E00"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M42 40 Q50 48 58 40" stroke="#5C2E00" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="37" r="2.2" fill="#D2691E"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="37" r="2.2" fill="#D2691E"/>
</svg>
